# Synthetic CFTC C0 fixtures

These files are deliberately synthetic and are used only for parser, PIT,
revision, and source-health tests. They are not CFTC downloads and cannot
satisfy a real-data or production-admission gate.

The production source identity and annual URL patterns are recorded in
`config/cftc_positioning.yml`; the actual release date must be supplied from
the CFTC release schedule when a captured file is admitted for review.
